Triage: queued, type Task — delete the root `dependencies` block (`coverage-v8@0.0.1-security` is npm's held security placeholder, almost certainly a typo residue for the already-present `@vitest/coverage-v8`) and refresh the lockfile. Honoring the body's ⚠️: root-lockfile churn has wide blast radius while agents hold worktrees, so the dispatching seat should land this standalone at a quiet moment, never as a rider. Size/model suggestion: S, sonnet.

Clause-②: no — a dependency removal; no contract accept/reject behaviour moves, no public surface widens.
Serial constraints cleared: nothing else open touches root `package.json` or the lockfile. #5459/#5712 dispatched in parallel are confined to `.claude/hooks/**` — disjoint. No cross-lane sibling asserts this file.

## Why this one is dispatchable as-is

The card names the exact entry, the exact file, and why it is residue — `coverage-v8@0.0.1-security` is npm's placeholder for a taken-over name (no code), almost certainly a scope-less typo for the `@vitest/coverage-v8` that is already present and correct in `devDependencies`. ⛔ No option menu, no open question: unlike several cards in this lane, this one does not ask anyone to choose.

⚠️ Two things the report must state rather than assume:
1. **`pnpm-lock.yaml` must be regenerated by the tool, not hand-edited.**
2. **Confirm nothing resolves the name** before removing — the card's own evidence is that zero source files import it, but re-measure on the current `main` rather than inheriting the card's reading.

**ACCEPT** — PM review of record, PR #5751. Verified against GitHub, not against the report's own account. `domain:devx` @ objectui seat (#5748), R1.

**Checked.**

| item | reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR form | draft ✓ · base `main` ✓ · first body line `Fixes #5437` ✓ |
| path surface (`get_files`, ⛔ not the report) | `package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` — **not on the governed register**, so this lands through the queue |
| scope vs declared file surface | exact match; nothing outside it |
| diff shape | `package.json` **−3 / +0** (the whole `dependencies` block); `pnpm-lock.yaml` **−9 / +0** across `importers:`, `packages:` and `snapshots:` — three coordinated sections with **zero added lines**, which is the shape a pnpm regeneration produces and a hand edit does not |
| changeset | none, and the gate agrees independently of the dev's claim: `Changeset Declaration` and `Changeset Fixed Group Check` both **success** |

**Spot-check that earned its keep.** The report's "lockfile regenerated, never hand-edited" is the one claim a PM cannot take on trust, because a hand-edited lockfile passes `--frozen-lockfile` if it happens to be self-consistent. The diff settles it structurally: removing a dependency by hand from `importers:` alone would leave the `packages:` and `snapshots:` entries behind. All three moved together, with no additions anywhere.

**Premise re-measurement accepted.** The dev re-derived the zero-consumer reading on `3ece13e3` rather than inheriting the card's `9f7d786bd` — as the order required — and reports every repo-wide hit for the bare string resolves to the scoped `@vitest/coverage-v8`.

## ⛔ Not released yet — CI has not converged, and that leg is mine

At review time, **8 of 21 checks are still `in_progress`** (`Test (shard 1..4/4)`, `Type Check`, `Lint`, `Doc Snippet Type Check`, `Bundle Analysis`) with **zero failures** and 10 completed green. `in_progress` is an honest reading, not a pass — so this PR stays draft until they complete.

On convergence I will re-read the path surface, flip ready, and enqueue.

## One landing constraint carried forward from triage

> root-lockfile churn has wide blast radius while agents hold worktrees, so the dispatching seat should land this standalone at a quiet moment, never as a rider.

Honoured, and the reading is recorded rather than assumed: the only other dispatch in flight from this seat (#5459 + #5712) is confined to `.claude/hooks/**` and touches **no** dependency or lockfile file, so it cannot conflict with this one and does not need to land first. If a dependency-touching card is in flight at flip time, this waits.

The 3 skipped are `Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard …)` and `dependabot` — skipped, not failed. The first two are the known shape this lane already carries cards for (#5436 `CODECOV_TOKEN` unset, #5422 `concurrency` cancelling the coverage job); nothing about this PR causes them.

## ⚠️ Why the green reading here is by-name, and why that matters in this repo

I read **each of the 21 check runs by name and conclusion** rather than taking an aggregate or the `check_suite.completed` signal as the verdict. That is standing discipline, but it is load-bearing specifically here: **#4986** (open in this lane) measures that this repo's merge queue has *never produced a single `merge_group` build* repo-wide, and that the required-check set does **not** include the four test shards, `Type Check` or `Lint`.

So on this PR the by-name read **is** the gate — the required set would have let it through on a much thinner reading. Recording that plainly rather than writing "CI green, queue will catch the rest", because in this repo the second half of that sentence is currently unbacked.

**MERGED — closing the loop.** PR #5751 merged `2026-08-23T04:50:15Z`; this card auto-closed `completed` at 04:50:16Z via its `Fixes` line.

Two readings taken, ⛔ not one:

| | |
|:--|:--|
| PR | `merged: true` **and** `merged_at` set (04:50:15Z) |
| card | `state: closed`, `state_reason: completed`, `closed_by_pull_requests` → #5751 `MERGED` |

**`pm:dispatched` stripped in the same pass.** A closed card still carrying a `pm:*` state label is a claim that work is in flight on a card that has left the board — the H22 shape, and the single largest half-state category on the objectstack patrol (31 of 94 findings this morning). Having filed on exactly that class earlier today, leaving one behind here would have been the cheapest possible way to prove the finding right. `domain:devx` is kept: routing is not state. The assignee is kept too — on a *closed* card it records who did the work, which is not the same defect as an assignee sitting on an *open* card (that shape is #5214's, recorded on the seat post).

**Lane baseline, first sample.** This seat had no measured dispatch→delivery latency; it does now:

| leg | elapsed |
|:--|--:|
| claim → draft PR pushed | **~5 min** (04:32:40Z → 04:37:42Z) |
| claim → merged | **~18 min** (04:32:40Z → 04:50:15Z) |

That is one sample from an S-mechanical card and ⛔ is not yet a liveness threshold — three to five are needed before it can be used to judge a silent agent dead.
